examples.text: upāli taṃ mahāvīrā'ti bhante mahāvīra, catūsu asaṅkhyeyyesu kappasatasahassesu sabbaññutaññāṇ'ādhigamāya vīriyavanta satthuno devamanussānaṃ anusāsakassa taṃ tava pāde pādayuge upāli bhikkhu vandati paṇāmaṃ karotī'ti attho.
evam'pi anupāyena, atthaṃ na labhate migo, visāṇato gavaṃ dohaṃ, yattha khīraṃ na vindati.
khuddā vitakkā sukhumā vitakkā, anuggatā manaso ubbilāpā, ete avidvā manaso vitakke, hurā huraṃ dhāvati bhantacitto.
so kuhako attānaṃ hananto suhataṃ katvā hanti vināseti, yathā kiṃ? vītaṃsen'eva pakkhimā'ti, vītaṃso'ti dīpakasakuṇo, tena. pakkhimā'ti sākuṇiko.
odaheyya okacaran'ti tesaṃ oke caramānaṃ viya ekaṃ dīpakamigaṃ ekasmiṃ ṭhāne ṭhapeyya. okacārikan'ti dīgharajjuyā bandhitaṃ'y'eva migiṃ.
